name: Dongguan Changlian New Materials Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Dongguan Changlian New Materials Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of water-based printing materials in China and internationally. The company offers water-based printing pastes comprising environmentally-friendly elastic, nylon, heat transfer, biodegradable, cracking, crack-resistant, fireproof, thick plate, and photochromic adhesives, as well as imitation silicon adhesives; environmentally-friendly base coats, foaming pulps, three-dimensional slurry pulling, webbing pulps, hot stamping pastes, transfer flocking pastes, cold ironing pastes, anti-sublimation primers, water slurry, matte top coats, shoe material thick board pulps, bag base coats, i…
